items.informal_name: Derivative Root Weight Function
items.type: Polynomial ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℝ
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ P $ over $ \mathbb{C} $ and complex numbers $ z, w $, this function returns $ 1 $ if $ z $ is a root of $ P $ and $ w = z $, $ 0 $ if $ z $ is a root but $ w \neq z $, and otherwise returns $ \frac{\text{mult}_P(w)}{\|z - w\|^2} $, where $ \text{mult}_P(w) $ is the multiplicity of $ w $ as a root of $ P $ and $ \|z - w\| $ is the complex modulus of $ z - w $.

items.informal_name: Approximation of Polynomials over Finite Fields via Modulo Operations
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] {b : Polynomial Fq},
  b ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {ε : ℝ},
      0 < ε →
        ∀ (A : Fin (Fintype.card Fq ^ ⌈-Real.log ε / Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Fq)⌉₊).succ → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any non-zero polynomial $ b $ over a finite field $ \mathbb{F}_q $ and any $ \varepsilon > 0 $, if $ A $ is a family of polynomials indexed by a finite set of size $ q^{\lceil -\log \varepsilon / \log q \rceil} $, then there exist distinct indices $ i_0, i_1 $ such that the $ \mathbb{F}_q $-cardinality-degree norm of $ (A(i_1) \bmod b - A(i_0) \bmod b) $ is less than $ \varepsilon \cdot q^{\deg b} $. Here, the cardinality-degree norm $ \text{cardPowDegree}(p) $ of a polynomial $ p $ is defined as $ q^{\deg p} $.

items.informal_name: Numerical Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.type: ℕ → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ
items.informal_description: A function that takes a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and another natural number $m$, returning a natural number used to establish well-founded recursion in the context of multivariate polynomials and Chevalley's theorem. It computes bounds by recursively applying $f$ to $n$ and decrementing $m$.

items.informal_name: Spectral value terms sequence
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : SeminormedRing R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → ℝ
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a seminormed ring $ R $, this function returns a sequence indexed by $ \mathbb{N} $ where each term is defined as $ \|p_n\|^{1/(d - n)} $ if $ n < d $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Here, $ p_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $, $ d $ is the natural degree of $ p $, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the seminorm on $ R $. This sequence captures the normed coefficients' growth rates relative to their distance from the polynomial's degree.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound for Polynomial Evaluation at Rational Points
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|
items.informal_description: For any linearly ordered field $ K $ with strict ordered ring structure, given a non-zero polynomial $ f \in \mathbb{Z}[X] $, integers $ a, b $ with $ b > 0 $, and assuming $ f\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) \neq 0 $, it holds that $ 1 \leq b^{\deg(f)} \cdot \left| f\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) \right| $, where $ \deg(f) $ denotes the natural degree of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Polynomial Partition with Degree Condition
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {b : Polynomial Fq},
      b ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (A : Fin n → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ t,
            ∀ (i₀ i₁ : Fin n),
              t i₀ = t i₁ ↔ ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$, positive real $\varepsilon$, non-zero polynomial $b \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, and function $A : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, there exists a function $t : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to \mathrm{Fin}(\#\mathbb{F}_q^{\lceil -\log \varepsilon / \log \#\mathbb{F}_q \rceil})$ such that for all $i_0, i_1 \in \mathrm{Fin}(n)$, $t(i_0) = t(i_1)$ if and only if $\deg(A(i_1) \bmod b - A(i_0) \bmod b) < \deg(b) \cdot \varepsilon$.

items.informal_name: Partitioning Polynomials with Bounded Differences Modulo a Non-Zero Polynomial
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {b : Polynomial Fq},
      b ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (A : Fin n → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ t,
            ∀ (i₀ i₁ : Fin n),
              t i₀ = t i₁ → ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$, positive real number $\varepsilon$, non-zero polynomial $b \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, and sequence of $n$ polynomials $A_0, \ldots, A_{n-1} \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, there exists a partition function $t$ mapping indices $\{0, \ldots, n-1\}$ to $\left\lceil \frac{-\log \varepsilon}{\log |\mathbb{F}_q|} \right\rceil$ classes such that for any two indices $i_0, i_1$ in the same class, the difference $A_{i_1} \mod b - A_{i_0} \mod b$ has $\text{cardPowDegree}$ strictly less than $\varepsilon \cdot \text{cardPowDegree}(b)$. Here, $\text{cardPowDegree}$ denotes a degree-like measure combining field cardinality and polynomial degree, and $|\mathbb{F}_q|$ is the size of the finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$.

items.informal_name: Degree of a Distinguished Polynomial Equals Order in Quotient Ring
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} (f h : PowerSeries R) {g : Polynomial R},
  g.IsDistinguishedAt I →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff h ∉ I → f = ↑g * h → ↑g.natDegree = ((PowerSeries.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) f).order
items.informal_description: If a polynomial $ f $ over a commutative ring $ R $ factors as $ f = g \cdot h $, where $ g $ is distinguished at an ideal $ I $ and the constant term of $ h $ is not in $ I $, then the natural degree of $ g $ equals the order of the image of $ f $ under the quotient map $ R \to R/I $. Here, the order refers to the smallest exponent with nonzero coefficient in the corresponding power series over the quotient ring.

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} [inst_1 : Decidable (a = 0)],
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = if a = 0 then ⊤ else ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_eq_nat
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f = ↑n ↔
    (∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ (Finsupp.weight w) d = n) ∧
      ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_monomial_of_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul_left_one_sub_of_lt_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : σ → ℕ) {R : Type u_3} [inst : Ring R] {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g →
    (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) (f * (1 - g)) = (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f

items.informal_name: Weighted order of a multivariate power series
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of $ f $ is the minimal natural number $ n $ such that there exists a monomial $ d $ with non-zero coefficient in $ f $ where the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $ equals $ n $. If $ f $ is the zero series, the weighted order is $ \top $ (infinity).

items.informal_name: Weighted Order of a Monomial Equals Its Weight for Non-zero Coefficients
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} [inst_1 : Decidable (a = 0)],
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = if a = 0 then ⊤ else ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of the monomial with coefficient $ a $ and exponent $ d $ is equal to the weight $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $ if $ a \neq 0 $, and $ \infty $ otherwise.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Upper Bound for Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the coefficient of a monomial $ d $ in $ f $ is non-zero, then the weighted order of $ f $ is less than or equal to the weight of $ d $, i.e., $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) \leq \sum_{i \in \operatorname{support} d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order of a Monomial in Multivariate Power Series with Non-Zero Coefficient
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, if $ f $ is a monomial $ \text{monomial}(d, a) $ where $ a \neq 0 $, then the weighted order of $ f $ with respect to a weight function $ w: \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $ is equal to the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $. In symbols, $ \text{weightedOrder}_w(\text{monomial}(d, a)) = \text{weight}_w(d) $.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound on Weighted Order of Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For any extended natural number $n$, if every monomial $d$ with $\text{weight}(w, d) < n$ has zero coefficient in the multivariate power series $f$, then $n \leq \text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$, where $\text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$ denotes the weighted order of $f$ with respect to the weight function $w$.

items.type:

    [inst : CommSemiring R] →
      {σ : Type u_3} → [AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : SemilatticeSup M] → [OrderBot M] → (σ → M) → MvPolynomial σ R → M
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weighting function $ w : \sigma \to M $ where $ M $ is a sup-semilattice, this function computes the supremum of the weights $ w(s) $ over all monomials $ s $ in the support of $ p $. The weight $ w(s) $ of a monomial $ s $ is defined as the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } s} s(i) \cdot v_i $ for some fixed vectors $ v_i $ associated with indices $ i $. The result is an element of $ M $ representing the weighted total degree of $ p $.

items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the coefficient of a monomial $ d $ in $ f $ is non-zero, then the weighted order of $ f $ is less than or equal to the weight of $ d $, i.e., $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) \leq \sum_{i \in \operatorname{support} d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $.
